definitions.gross_tokens: Reported input + output; cached/cache-write input and reasoning output are subsets, never added to gross.
definitions.http_timing: Backend call is timed independently; source snapshot observation overhead is measured separately and included in agent workflow time.
definitions.limits: Four authored feature tasks in existing development repositories, two repetitions, selected external/original tests, unblinded conditional tool guidance, filesystem/provider caches, instrumentation overhead; exploratory package comparison, no isolated component effect or broad savings claim.
definitions.missing_usage: No completed-turn receipt means unavailable usage, including potentially charged work before a timeout; it is never treated as zero.
definitions.observer_timing: CLI events can be batched/queued; reception spans do not measure exact tool, queue, provider, or thinking time.
definitions.output_proxies: UTF-8 bytes and optional cached cl100k counts of published path-redacted completed tool output strings; not provider input, billed tokens, or exact model-visible history.
definitions.pair_change: 100*(MCP/baseline-1); negative is lower. All pairs and correctness-qualified pairs have separate denominators.
definitions.qualified_pairs: Both trials finalized, completed normally and passed frozen selected/upstream gates, with equal fixture and prompt hashes; this outcome-selected subset can be biased and can contain supplemental defects.
definitions.redaction: Output proxies use published strings. Path redaction can change raw source/text hashes; recorded snapshot checks and optional raw payload linkage retain that distinction. Repeated identical payloads can yield explicitly ambiguous links.
definitions.rereads: Exact full delivered excerpt substring seen in later command stdout; not complete evidence or phase attribution.
definitions.scope_clues: Query mentions of tests/pytest/fixtures are marked when the frozen source root excludes the top-level tests tree; a heuristic, not proof of intended scope or causal attribution.
definitions.source_checks: Recorded HTTP snapshot checks plus recomputed delivered UTF-8 hashes/physical-line lengths; raw event linkage is available only with ignored evaluator logs.
definitions.source_overlap: Fully contained same-path source ranges with exact text at that location, and exact source excerpts seen in later same-path MCP results. Repetition can be justified by edits or new queries; no waste, paid-saving, or causal claim.
definitions.structured_fields: CLI normalization can add null structured fields; structured_payload_present requires a non-null value. A null field is not a duplicate payload or billing evidence.
definitions.timeout_time: A timed-out CLI duration measures observed resource time to cutoff, not a successful completion time; its completion time is censored at that limit.
definitions.uncached_input: Input minus cached input only where both are reported; cache writes are separately reported and not subtracted.
